name: B K Suraj
hero_headline: A space for what comes next.
hero_intro: Based in Busan, I build practical projects, create photo and video work, and write about the ideas that keep me curious.
about: Curiosity usually comes before a plan. A question becomes something to read about, a small project to build, or a moment worth recording. Studying Intelligence Computing at Dong-Eui University gives some of that work a technical foundation; photography, video, and writing give it room to move. Learning independently has made trying, revising, and starting again part of the process. XuVerse brings those interests together as a record of work in progress, with space for ideas that have not found their final shape yet.
philosophy: Learn by trying. Keep what works. Improve what needs another attempt.
projects_intro: Practical projects, small experiments, and the lessons they leave behind.
articles_intro: Thoughts on living, looking, and learning to pay attention.
research_intro: Questions explored through reading, observation, and careful interpretation.
media_intro: Selected video and visual communication work.
contact_intro: Have an idea, a question, or something worth exploring? Reach out through any of the links below.
availability: Open to conversations, projects, and collaborations.
resume_summary: Intelligence Computing undergraduate based in Busan, with interests across practical software projects, media creation, independent learning, and student community work.
